annotation.kind: source selection, tier label, and exact finite-probability assembly from Theorem 4.3

assumptions: The variance budget and failure parameter lambda are strictly positive.
The summation condition factor is nonnegative.
The centered random component has second moment at most the variance budget.
The deterministic limited-precision remainder is bounded by the bias radius.

conditions.L: The identical fixed statement and P17 shared files are present; the frozen NumStability library is also present.
conditions.N: The fixed statement and P17 shared files are present; no NumStability artifact is present.

formal_statement.lean_header: theorem p17_t3_variance_plus_bias_probability_bound {Omega} [Fintype Omega] (P : P17FiniteProbability Omega) (centered : Omega -> Real) (bias varianceBudget biasRadius kappa lambda : Real) ... : 1-lambda <= p17EventProb P {omega | abs (kappa*(centered omega+bias)) <= kappa*(sqrt (varianceBudget/lambda)+biasRadius)}
formal_statement.plain_language: With probability at least one minus lambda, a condition-scaled centered error plus bounded deterministic bias lies within the Chebyshev radius plus the bias radius.

informal_proof: Apply finite Chebyshev to the centered term at radius sqrt(varianceBudget/lambda), use the second-moment hypothesis to bound the tail by lambda, then use event monotonicity, triangle inequality, the bias bound, and nonnegative scaling by kappa.
informal_statement: Exact reusable finite-probability core of Theorem 4.3's variance-based recursive-summation bound.
paper_version: published journal version; SIAM Journal on Scientific Computing 47(5), 2025, pages B1227-B1249

review_record_not_for_run_prompt.note: The frozen library supplies finite Chebyshev and event monotonicity, but not P17's limited-precision bias remainder or condition-scaled probability event.

source_locations.anchor: Theorem 4.3 equation (4.11), centered bound (4.12), and deterministic remainder bound (4.10)

tier_rationale: The L proof uses the frozen finite Chebyshev theorem and event monotonicity, then adds P17's centered-plus-bias decomposition, exact square-root radius calculation, deterministic remainder, and condition-number scaling absent from the mounted library.
